mission.description: The drone leaves its base at (-14380, 21350) and has to end up at (27362, -3154). On the way it must stop at A (Helios Horst Schmidt Clinic (HSK) Heliport) at (-29309, 1512), B (Frankfurt University Hospital Heliport) at (4461, 5076), C (August Euler Airfield) at (-982.3, -21821), D (Hanau Fire Department Emergency Heliport) at (24484, 10601); visit A before B; visit B before C; visit C before D. Keep it no lower than 40 m and no higher than 80 m. The restricted areas and obstacles (Z1 [Frankfurt Main Airport (EDDF, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z2 [Frankfurt-Egelsbach Airport (EDFE, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z3 [Wiesbaden Army Airfield (ETOU, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m]) are off limits, and that includes cutting across a corner of one on the way between two stops. The whole trip may not be longer than 157291 meters. The battery only allows 164460 energy units, where energy = route length + 30 x total climb (so low altitudes save battery). (START is Oberems Glider Field; DEST is Zellhausen Sport Airfield.) Coordinates are meters east/north of the region center.
